analysis_note: All eligible pathways are included; this is a census of both frozen pools.
public_replay_scope: Reviewer-level agreement, exact adjudication coverage, reconstruction of all final labels, and downstream pathway statistics from public metadata-sanitized completed workbooks.
agreement_reproducibility: All seven pre-adjudication agreement tables are independently recomputed from 805 paired ratings.
adjudication_reproducibility: All 92 required third-expert rating-dimension decisions are independently validated against Expert A and Expert B source labels, comments, pathway text, and template.
supersession_reason: Completed reviewer workbooks became available after v3.1.1, enabling reviewer-level replay. Manuscript-facing scientific estimates are unchanged.
